gate: M10/1 Active; app GPU file playback delivered; complete common-codec acceptance remains open
deliverable: Native MapGyver File workers select the renderer's exact adapter, decode supported files into D3D11 frames and asynchronously publish resident GPU images. Unsupported hardware, source admission and native failures explicitly reopen software playback on the same media clock.

ownership.pool_admission: Decoder open now requires GpuFrameBudget. Padded dimensions, native NV12/P010 storage and fixed surface count are reserved before av_hwframe_ctx_init. FFmpeg's public pool destructor owns the reservation; old frame/pool references retain it across codec replacement and shutdown. Existing 32-surface and padded-pixel limits remain.
ownership.aggregate_gpu_cap: The host reserves one quarter of measured selected-adapter admission, capped at768 MiB, for shared decoder/conversion/bridge storage and subtracts it from renderer target admission. The cap survives native session recreation. Retained old allocations still compete for capacity. This accounts known storage, not all driver-private or third-party allocation overhead.
ownership.clock: Software and hardware use the same timestamp sampler. At most one hardware conversion is pending. Its original epoch/cycle is checked under the common VideoControl publication fence before either completed pixels or step neighbours become visible. Busy slots retry while paused; displaced storage is disposed outside outer control/output locks.
ownership.recovery: Source-local fallback withdraws the old stream, reports its typed failure and reopens software without changing transport settings. Demand/native owner recreation attempts hardware again. Existing bounded missing/corrupt-file retry remains. Session shutdown waits for file workers and retained GPU pools/imports before replacement.
ownership.protocol: No protocol or TypeScript declarations change. File/Playback/Seek/Rate/Loop remain existing typed Parameters and public operation adapters. Existing full-suite generated-contract checks pass. No frontend product source changes.

software.initial_failure_retained: The first parallel app run had610 passes, one failure and two ignored: existing source_mutations_inspection_and_atomic_rejection_match_ui_and_script_callers hit Script app-operation lifetime capacity exhausted. No capacity was raised or unrelated script implementation changed. The complete serial rerun passed.

Exact mixed-rate steps, caller/callback/history parity, Reference stream sharing, retained Matrix ownership and missing/unsupported/relink recovery remain verified.
